headline: 'At least 10 years...' Annamalai Lashes Out at Thalapathy Vijay Over Parandur Airport
summary: Annamalai criticized the Tamil Nadu government's cancellation of the Parandur airport project. He warned that starting at a new location could delay Chennai's second airport by at least 10 years.
why: Airport projects drive infrastructure investment and construction activity, and cancellations or relocations can shift timelines for contractors and property developers.
